description: This source file defines the HealthRouteSupplier class, which provides an Akka HTTP route for health check endpoints. It handles asynchronous health status retrieval from an actor, processes the response, and generates appropriate HTTP responses based on health status or failures.

classes.name: HealthRouteSupplier
